import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']
palette = dict(zip(df['species'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5,
               color=palette[species])
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
               label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5,
               color=palette[species])
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plots for petal length by species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
bp = ax3.boxplot([df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].values 
                   for species in df['species'].unique()],
                  labels=df['species'].unique(),
                  patch_artist=True,
                  notch=True,
                  widths=0.6)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
for element in ['whiskers', 'fliers', 'means', 'medians', 'caps']:
    plt.setp(bp[element], color='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Violin plot for sepal length by species
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
parts = ax4.violinplot([df[df['species'] == species]['sepal_length'].values 
                        for species in df['species'].unique()],
                       positions=range(len(df['species'].unique())),
                       showmeans=True,
                       showmedians=True,
                       widths=0.7)
for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[i])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
    pc.set_edgecolor('black')
    pc.set_linewidth(1)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(df['species'].unique())))
ax4.set_xticklabels(df['species'].unique())
ax4.set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sepal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Flower Species Analysis: Comprehensive Comparison', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
